# Parser reference inputs

- `powershell-v7.6.9/`: Parser test files from PowerShell/PowerShell tag v7.6.9,
  commit `bf5fc434120666e5f1a8d1dfd6ecac7efc17a4be`. Original headers and MIT
  `LICENSE.txt` are retained. The oracle extracts quoted string values and
  script-block bodies without invoking the tests.
- `airbus/`: original corpus and MIT license from airbus-cert/tree-sitter-powershell,
  commit `65ea6919e816a7ac142acec7ee72757f89db8439`. `SOURCE.json` lists the fetched
  files. `oracle/airbus.json` contains the source inputs between corpus delimiters,
  including the obfuscated samples; tree-sitter's expected trees are unused.
- `oracle/edges.json`: hand-written grammar, Unicode, version, malformed-input,
  and semantic-check cases.
- `oracle/expressions.json`, `expressions-more.json`, and `enum-types.json`:
  expression-owner cases covering operators, literals, types, members, strings,
  attributes, classes, enums, and malformed input.
- `oracle/windows-probe.json`: 22 PowerShell calls from the task's Codex and
  Antigravity laptop transcripts. The user and project path are anonymized.
- `dotnet-unicode-bmp.json`: generated by `oracle/unicode-bmp.ps1` under pwsh
  7.6.9. It records the runtime version, category runs, uppercase mappings, and
  selected ordinal comparisons.

These are test fixtures. They are not embedded in the application.
